dedupe_keys.name: data and models for exploring real time control of stormwater systems for mitigating flood risk due to sea level rise

description: Data and models for exploring real-time control of stormwater systems for mitigating flood risk due to sea level rise is a data set deposited in CUAHSI by its authors Jeff Sadler (University of Virginia). This resource contains data and models that were used to produce results for a paper published in the Journal of Hydrology. The models are for a neighborhood in Norfolk, Virginia USA that suffers from frequent coastal flooding. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2020. Formats: JSON, CSV, Image, Python. Size stated: 909143570 bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is This resource is shared under the Creative Commons Attribution CC BY.. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
